newsitem.title: INDIA: Merger of Nicholas Piramal, Piramal Health approved.
newsitem.headline: Merger of Nicholas Piramal, Piramal Health approved.

text.p: Pharmaceutical firm Nicholas Piramal India Ltd. said on Thursday the Bombay High Court had approved its plan for a merger with Piramal Healthcare Ltd.
"The pharamceutical business of Piramal Healthcare is now spun off and merged with Nicholas Piramal India Ltd.," the company said in a statement.
The exchange ratio has been set at three equity shares of Nicholas Piramal for every four of Piramal Healthcare, the statement added.
The merger is to take effect from June 1, 1996, it said.
Earlier, the firm had received court permission to go ahead with its plans for a merger with Boehringer Mannheim India Ltd., with effect from April 1, 1996, the statement said.
"The mergers will result in all the pharmaceutical business of Piramal Enterprises being managed within a single entity, namely Nicholas Piramal India Ltd," it added.
"With this significant restructuring Nicholas Piramal India Ltd now ranks among the top five in the Indian pharmaceutical industry with a turnover exceeding 5 billion rupees."
